intro: By using our website or submitting your information, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We may collect personal information when you fill out a form, request a quote, place an order, contact us, subscribe to updates, or communicate with our team.

This information may include: Full name, Email address, Phone number, Company name, Project details, Billing information, Mailing address, Website or business information, and any additional information voluntarily provided by the user.
We may also collect non-personal information such as browser type, device information, IP address, pages visited, referral source, and website usage behavior.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: We use collected information to respond to inquiries, process orders and service requests, communicate project updates, provide customer support, improve our website and services, send relevant updates or promotional information, understand client needs and preferences, maintain internal records, and improve user experience.
We may contact clients through email, phone, SMS, WhatsApp, or other communication channels related to their project or service request.

sections.title: Data Protection
paragraphs: We take reasonable steps to protect personal information from unauthorized access, misuse, loss, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.
While we use industry-standard security practices, no online transmission or electronic storage method is 100% secure. Therefore, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: Third-Party Sharing
paragraphs: Go Execution does not sell, rent, or trade personal information to third parties.

We may share information only when necessary with trusted service providers, payment processors, hosting providers, development teams, marketing platforms, or support tools required to deliver our services. These third parties are only allowed to use information as needed to perform services on our behalf.
We may also disclose information if required by law, legal process, court order, or to protect our rights, safety, users, or business operations.

sections.title: Payment Information
paragraphs: Go Execution does not intentionally store sensitive payment card information on its website unless processed through a secure and authorized payment provider.
Clients are advised not to share confidential payment details, passwords, or sensitive information through unsecured communication channels.

sections.title: Cookies Policy
paragraphs: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to improve user experience, remember preferences, analyze website traffic, and understand how visitors interact with our website.
Users can disable cookies through their browser settings. However, some website features may not function properly if cookies are disabled.

sections.title: Analytics and Tracking
paragraphs: We may use analytics tools to collect general website usage data, such as pages visited, time spent on the website, traffic sources, and user behavior.
This information helps us improve website performance, design, content, and marketing efforts.

sections.title: Social Media Features
paragraphs: Our website may include social media buttons, widgets, pixels, or embedded tools from platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Google, or others.
These tools may collect certain information such as IP address, browser data, or page activity. Your interaction with these tools is governed by the privacy policy of the respective platform.

sections.title: Email and Mobile Communication
paragraphs: By submitting your email address or phone number, you consent to receive communication related to your inquiry, project, service updates, promotional offers, or business communication from Go Execution.
You can opt out of promotional communication at any time by contacting us or following unsubscribe instructions where available.
For SMS or mobile communication, you may reply "STOP" or request removal from our contact list.

sections.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We may retain personal information as long as necessary to provide services, manage client records, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements.
Users may request deletion or correction of their personal information by contacting us.

sections.title: Your Rights
paragraphs: You may request access to the personal information we hold about you. You may also request correction, update, deletion, or restriction of your personal data, subject to applicable legal and business requirements.

sections.title: Links to Other Websites
paragraphs: Our website may contain links to third-party websites. Go Execution is not responsible for the privacy practices, content, security, or policies of external websites.
Users are encouraged to review the privacy policies of any third-party websites they visit.

sections.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
paragraphs: Go Execution may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page. Users are encouraged to review this page periodically.

intro: By purchasing, approving, or using our services, the client agrees to the terms mentioned below.

sections.title: Revision Policy
paragraphs: Revisions are provided according to the selected package or agreed project scope. Clients may request revisions within the agreed limits as long as the original concept, direction, and project scope remain the same.

Revision requests must be clear, consolidated, and related to the original brief. Major changes, new concepts, additional pages, new features, or changes outside the approved scope may require additional charges.
Standard revision turnaround time may vary depending on the complexity of the request, but we aim to complete revisions as quickly as possible.

sections.title: Refund Policy
paragraphs: Refund requests are reviewed on a case-by-case basis and are subject to the project stage, scope, and work already completed.

A refund may only be considered if the request is made before approval of initial concepts, designs, drafts, mockups, or project direction. Once the client approves the initial work, requests revisions, or confirms continuation of the project, the project will be considered active and the refund request may no longer be applicable.
No refund will be issued once final files, source files, website access, completed assets, approved designs, or completed deliverables have been provided.

If a client becomes unresponsive for an extended period, delays feedback, or does not provide required material, Go Execution will not be responsible for project delays. Projects may be placed on hold, and restarting the project may require an additional fee.
Discounted bundles, custom packages, rush delivery fees, third-party costs, domain, hosting, stock assets, paid tools, plugins, and external service charges are non-refundable.

sections.title: Project Approval
paragraphs: Once a client approves a design, content, website layout, logo concept, or any project deliverable, Go Execution will proceed based on that approval. Any major changes after approval may be considered additional work and may require extra charges.

sections.title: Client Responsibilities
paragraphs: The client is responsible for providing accurate information, project requirements, content, images, access credentials, brand material, and feedback on time.
Go Execution will not be responsible for delays caused by incomplete information, late feedback, missing assets, or third-party platform issues.

sections.title: Quality Assurance
paragraphs: We aim to deliver work according to the client’s project brief and agreed requirements. Our team follows a professional process to ensure that the final output is aligned with the approved direction.
However, subjective preferences may vary. Revisions are provided to improve and refine the work within the agreed scope.

sections.title: Delivery Policy
paragraphs: Project delivery timelines depend on the selected service, project complexity, client feedback, and required approvals.
Estimated timelines are shared before or during the project. Delays may occur if the client does not provide timely feedback, required content, approvals, or access.
Final files, website links, project assets, or deliverables will be shared through email, project dashboard, cloud storage, or any agreed communication method.

sections.title: Domain and Hosting
paragraphs: Domain and hosting services are only included if mentioned in the selected package or custom proposal.

If the client chooses to use their own hosting provider, Go Execution may assist with setup where possible, but third-party hosting performance, downtime, security, backups, or technical issues will not be the responsibility of Go Execution.
Email accounts are only provided if included in the package or supported by the selected hosting setup.

sections.title: Ownership Rights

Concepts, drafts, unused designs, rejected ideas, internal files, working files, and preliminary versions remain the property of Go Execution unless specifically purchased or agreed in writing.

sections.title: Communication Policy

Go Execution will not be responsible for any communication, payment request, or instruction received from unauthorized email addresses, numbers, or third parties pretending to represent the company.

sections.title: Customer Support
paragraphs: We aim to provide timely customer support for active projects and completed work where applicable. Support availability may depend on the selected package, service type, or maintenance agreement.
Ongoing support, maintenance, updates, backups, and website changes after project completion may require a separate maintenance plan.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
